sections.h: The Bestiary and the Lower Dimension
sections.t:
[REM-126](#/rem-126) - a ring-shaped library, but titanic, as big as a planet. Here there are billions of books and/or pieces of information, including: the Bestiary (encyclopedia of the "Monsters", that is, of the magical artifacts)
[REM-127](#/rem-127) - an encyclopedia on the Monsters, each with its own story, its inventor, and its section in the Library
Lower Dimension - A collapsed hyperverse that serves as the physical manifestation of [REM-000](#/rem-000)'s body, simplified into one dimension.
The Stalkers' ability to integrate with other monsters (both human-made and anomalous in nature) has proven to be an invaluable asset. These creatures, referred to as "Monsters," serve as both distraction and combat support.

sections.h: Addendum •  Following SCP-3812 discovery, and the subsequent confirmation of the existence
sections.t:
Addendum •  Following SCP-3812 [[REM-902](#/rem-902)] discovery, and the subsequent confirmation of the existence of higher narratives over the fictional universe, The Beyonders [[REM-001](#/rem-001)] are currently the sole tribunal of all lower universes, in an executive position even higher than the SCP Foundation. The SCP Foundation has actively tried to cure The Beyonders [[REM-001](#/rem-001)]. None of them has been successfully rescued.
Abilities • The Beyonder [[REM-002](#/rem-002)] sacrificed his voice to inherit a fraction of The Marquis of Death [[REM-228](#/rem-228)]'s powers: he can speak the Word of Wyncham [[REM-043](#/rem-043)] making any fictional character obey his orders; his power has cognitohazard effects on most conscious beings. The following is a list of all discovered species stated to be immune to his power: angels [DragonBall], na'vi [Avatar], red martians [Barsoom] [...].
Appearance  • ███████ ███████'s age and appearance is [REDACTED], and does not concern the Foundation. However, The Beyonder [[REM-002](#/rem-002)] appears to be in his 40s, although speculations analyzing his speech pattern suggest he was inexplicably born between 1500 and 1750 AD. He sacrificed his eyes in Anansi's Pot of Wisdom [[REM-037](#/rem-037)] to gain full knowledge of the Many Worlds Interpretation of Quantum Physics. He wears Freya's falcon cloak [[REM-038](#/rem-038)] and Aphrodite's girdle [[REM-039](#/rem-039)]. He wears The Aegis in his left hand, and All Black The Necrosword in his shadow.

sections.h: From the source: An Hourglass of Blood and Dreams
sections.t: That was the last time I had seen her. As soon as I found out she had left, I too departed. I had been traveling the world for years, spending my time fighting to become stronger, learning from those who had come before me, and making a name for myself.  I built connections with the likes of Vegapunk and Germa 66 [[REM-819](#/rem-819)]. I learned swordsmanship. I fought with one of the Supreme Grade Swords, the black blade Lazarus. But when I first wielded it was just a common sword. But never, not even once, I forgot about her.  Not once did the memories fade from my mind. I would think about her, dream about her, daydream about her. I wanted her again. More than anything.  And there she was. Beautiful, radiant, and vulnerable. She was alone now, as alone as I had been. A scorch of light trilled on her figure, revealing that her body was covered in scars. I stared at her scars and her body, taking in everything. I approached her, but I knew there was something off. It was a trap.

Suit powered by Amaterasu, Nabu, Gilgamesh, [REM-224](#/rem-224) and Laka. — Quote: "REM-420, referred to as the "A.N.G.E.L. Suit," is a highly anomalous and divinely engineered exosuit. The suit is constructed from a combination of an aviator mask (including…"

Special Containment Procedures:
REM-420 is to be contained within a high-security, multi-dimensional vault located at Site-██. The device itself should remain inactive unless specifically authorized for testing or research under controlled conditions. Due to the divine nature of the suit’s components, only Level 4 personnel with prior approval from Dr. Daedalus [[REM-XXX](#/rem-xxx)] may engage with or interact with REM-420.
Access to the blueprint, which is located within an unknown space station orbiting the Armageddon Loop [[REM-248](#/rem-248)], is strictly prohibited unless necessary for continued study. Any unauthorized attempts to access the blueprint or activate REM-420 will result in immediate termination of access privileges, followed by a standard memory wipe procedure.

Description:
REM-420, referred to as the "A.N.G.E.L. Suit," is a highly anomalous and divinely engineered exosuit. The suit is constructed from a combination of an aviator mask (including helmet, goggles, and oxygen mask) and a pair of wings derived from the divine entities known as seraphim. The wings, which are strapped to the user's back, are biologically and metaphysically connected to the suit’s power source.
The suit’s core design and functionality are based on five distinct divine entities, each bestowing extraordinary enhancements to the wearer. These attributes are as follows:
The Energy of Amaterasu: The suit’s power source, which provides an unquantifiable amount of energy. This energy is metabolized by the user, granting them superior physical and metaphysical capabilities.
The Wisdom of Nabu: Enhances the wearer’s cognitive functions, allowing them to understand and utilize the suit’s powers effectively.
The Strength of Gilgamesh: Endows the user with immense physical strength, enabling feats beyond normal human comprehension.
The Invulnerability of Esfandiyār [[REM-224](#/rem-224)]: Provides near-invulnerability to the user within the paracosm, allowing them to withstand unimaginable physical and metaphysical stresses.
The Stamina of Laka: Grants the wearer an extraordinary ability to endure and process the immense energy produced by Amaterasu without succumbing to its destructive force.

sections.t: Relentless hunter-armour forged in The Forge. — Quote: "REM-467, commonly known as "The Stalker," is a small-sized automaton designed with a singular purpose: to track and neutralize a designated target object. Standing at 1.2 meters…"

Special Containment Procedures:
REM-467, known as "The Stalker," must be contained in a high-security robotics facility equipped with electromagnetic fields capable of disrupting its internal guidance system. The Stalker is to be housed in a small, reinforced containment chamber, capable of sustaining extreme pressure and environmental conditions. Due to its autonomous nature and its relentless pursuit behavior, any attempts to stop the Stalker before it completes its mission must be handled with extreme caution.
Personnel tasked with interacting with REM-467 must undergo a thorough analysis of its tracking algorithm and mission parameters. Given its pursuit-driven programming, subjects should not be placed in close proximity to any identified target objects unless fully debriefed. Only authorized personnel are allowed to initiate deactivation protocols.

Description:
REM-467, commonly known as "The Stalker," is a small-sized automaton designed with a singular purpose: to track and neutralize a designated target object. Standing at 1.2 meters tall, the Stalker is an intricate golem-like creation, composed of reinforced metal alloys and organic compounds, with several mechanical appendages designed for both mobility and offensive action. Despite its small size, the Stalker is capable of extreme precision and persistence, guided by a complex algorithm that directs its relentless pursuit until the target object is neutralized.
The Stalker operates autonomously, without any true consciousness, and is driven by an algorithm designed to hunt and destroy. The algorithm can be overridden or modified to target specific objects, and it is programmed to identify these targets with near-infallible accuracy. Upon detection, the Stalker will begin its pursuit and will not cease its actions until the object has been neutralized or destroyed.
The Stalker is powered by a rare and anomalous space fungus, which serves as both a biological and technological fuel source. The fungus is a form of organic energy storage that enhances the Stalker's computational capabilities, enabling it to adapt its tactics and strategies as required. This fungus has been linked to a number of unidentified extraterrestrial phenomena, and attempts to replicate it have failed.

Established by the SCP Foundation, The Beyonders [[REM-001](#/rem-001)] are responsible for safeguarding the fictional universes by eliminating or deleting any sentient creatures that pose a threat to the continuity.
I have a second personality, namely The Beyonder [[REM-002](#/rem-002)]. He is a violent and dangerous criminal with command inducement powers. Suffering from fictophilia, hypersexuality, and power incontinence, it's a dictator sailing across the outerverse with a crew of seemingly brainwashed fictional characters, nicknamed The Beyonders [[REM-001](#/rem-001)].

sections.h: From the source: Il Quadrante delle emozioni
sections.t:
Everything exists. When the afterlife finally sat, the [REM-118](#/rem-118) was covered by my eyes. The golden chalice was still in the bishop's hand, a holy grail protector of light and lethal weapon against darkness. It was a simple soul without body and, just like a soul in agony in the underworld, his gaze was always distorted compared to reality. His composure, the proud essence of victory, was still intact. But on his face there never appeared a smile, because as long as he exists, there will also be [REM-118](#/rem-118), and the victory of a battle will never be the victory of a war.

110. Does [REM-115](#/rem-115) hate the golden chalice?

sections.h: From the source: Paradis i Ander Reus — Worldbuilding Encyclopedia
sections.t: The day after she wakes up. She stands up, looking at Seraphil. She raped her. All those emotions make her decide to leave the furnace. She takes her fuchsia robe on her. Outside the entrance, she notices a crown of thorns made out of metal, decorated with dead roses. That's clearly a gift from Efesto. She wears it, and blood begins to flow from her cranium. She looks at the landscape. Her face is messed up. Her eyes show profound sadness. She has nowhere to go, and nobody is here to greet her. She has no place outside of that cave.
